notes._source: Frequent Miler Reasonable Redemption Values, treated as definitive by the site owner (2026-09-20): https://frequentmiler.com/reasonable-redemption-values-rrvs/ . Reference copy: data/reference/frequentmiler-rrv.json.
notes.ultimate-rewards: withUnlocker = travel redemption (needs a Sapphire or Ink Preferred to transfer); withoutUnlocker = cash redemption, 1.0 cent.
notes.citi-thankyou: withoutUnlocker is the cash-out value, 1.0 cent (site owner). Transfers need a Strata Elite or Strata Premier.
notes.capital-one-miles: withoutUnlocker is the cash-out value, 1.0 cent (site owner). Transfers need a miles-earning card.
notes.leading-hotels-leaders-club: Frequent Miler lists about 8.0 and calls it variable.
notes.all-accor: Not included: Frequent Miler gives 2.0 euro cents, not a US-dollar value.
